newsitem.title: UK: UK Bemrose says current trade as expected.
newsitem.headline: UK Bemrose says current trade as expected.

text.p: British promotional products company Bemrose Corportion Plc said on Friday that its trading in the first four months of the current financial year was progressing according to its expectations.
"I anticipate another satfisfactory result for the year," Rodger Booth, Bemrose chairman told an annual meeting of shareholders.
Booth said the group's security print division was performing well, continuing its last year's growth.
"Results from initial mailings in the UK and Canada are very strong," he said.
The company's share price was a penny ahead at 413 1/2p shortly after Booth addressed shareholders.
